title: HumanReviewVerification
description: The AUTHORITATIVE machine model for FR-083 location-aware verification and the FR-080-082 Human Review Report. One record per AUTHORIZED delivery attempt that had >= 1 applicable human-review decision (research §25 / §26) — written whether verification PASSES or FAILS (FR-084). The <base>_review_report.md is a RENDERING of this record (same 'one model renders both' rule as every FR-057 pair) and holds no state not derivable from: the human-review queue, the append-only resolution history (currently-applicable via sequence_index, research §22.2), the review-authorization event log, the RunContext, the RenderMap, and the delivered Markdown. Deterministic body (no wall-clock, no random id); the verification record + Report JOIN the FR-053a run-twice deterministic core (research §25.5 / §14). A `verification_failed` item is ALSO emitted as a validation issue with review_item_id + defect_class (FR-084 / research §25.6) and blocks successful delivery. v2.1 (audit remediation): lineage carries the ordered closed-enum `segment_transforms` chain (H1) and `collapsed_into` edges (M7); items carry `defect_class` = originating stage (H5); render span / per-segment spans / final-Markdown span+excerpt are null for `not_located` (H4); a segment may have MULTIPLE rendered spans (M11).

delivered_markdown.description: The Markdown artifact this record was verified against. `path` is `intermediates/<base>.<run_id>.unverified.md` while the delivery gate is open and becomes `<base>.md` only after step 5 of research §25.7 publishes it. Its `run_id` MUST equal the record `run_id` AND the `authorized_run_id` of a matching review-authorization event. Serialization is pinned by research §25.1 (binary UTF-8, no BOM, LF only, no Unicode normalization); `markdown_sha256` is sha256 of those exact bytes.

items.description: One VerificationItem per applicable human-review decision (the currently-applicable resolution per applicability_key, derived by sequence_index authority — research §22.2).

summary.description: Counts + derived verdict. The Human Review Report PRINTS `status` VERBATIM (research §26) — it never re-decides PASS/FAIL.

resolved.description: Applicable decisions that have a currently-applicable human_confirmed resolution. This record is only ever written for an AUTHORIZED run (zero open items), so in practice `resolved == decisions_applicable` always — the field is kept for the Report's at-a-glance summary and as an explicit cross-check (L4).

status.description: FR-080: PASS iff failed == 0 && verified == decisions_applicable; else FAIL. Purely derived from the counts — no separate stored verdict.

span.description: Half-open Unicode-codepoint offset range [start, end) into delivered_markdown_text := <artifact bytes>.decode('utf-8') (research §25.1). delivered_markdown_text[start:end] is the AUTHORITATIVE slice. A record MAY also carry derived byte offsets / line-col as cross-checks, but the codepoint offsets are the sole authority.

byte_start.description: OPTIONAL derived UTF-8 byte offset — integrity cross-check only, not authoritative.

byte_end.description: OPTIONAL derived UTF-8 byte offset — integrity cross-check only, not authoritative.

segmentTransform.description: One deterministic operation that changed a segment's OWN character sequence between the CED literal and the rendered bytes (research §25.2, H1). CLOSED ENUM — not an open normalizer. Verification re-applies exactly this ordered chain and nothing else.

kind.description: dehyphenate (stage 3, FR-014); reflow_whitespace (stage 3, FR-013/FR-016); markdown_escape (stage 5, renderer contract for FR-012 output); html_escape (stage 5, FR-020-022 HTML table path); cell_newline_br (stage 5, FR-020-022); ocr_marker (stage 5, FR-025, inline marker only).

permitted_by.description: The FR (or renderer-contract reference) that permits this transform kind. MUST be consistent with `kind` per the research §25.2 table.

candidateEvidence.description: One candidate shown to the reviewer (FR-062a/FR-062d/FR-075). Shared shape reused by the queue and resolution schemas (L3). Copied unchanged from the queue item for the Report (FR-081).

structuralContext.description: Copied from the queue item for the Report (FR-081) — the section / table / row / column where the reviewed content sits, where known. `null` when no structural context was captured.

verificationItem.description: One applicable human-review decision traced review -> source-backed segment -> resolution -> CED -> semantic/render -> final-Markdown span, and checked THERE (research §25.3-25.5). NEVER by global string search (FR-083).

resolution_id.description: The currently-applicable resolution verified (FR-076), content-bound per human-review-resolution.schema.json v2.1.

lineage.description: The review -> CED -> semantic -> render chain (research §25.3). `incomplete = true` (a hop could not be resolved) drives status=verification_failed / failure_reason=not_located.

reconciliation_decision_id.description: The human_confirmed ReconciliationDecision id carried by the CED; `null` => the CED does not carry this decision => defect_class routes to reconciliation_error (research §25.6).

ced_accepted.description: What the CED actually accepted for the reviewed location — literal: the AcceptedSegment.text (string); order: the CED accepted order of the reviewed segments (array of segment_id). Compared against `expected` for the reconciliation_error test (research §25.6).

semantic_block_ids.description: SemanticDocument blocks whose provenance includes the accepted segments. Empty when the lineage is incomplete.

spans.description: MAY be multiple (M11) — a merged HTML cell, a segment split across Markdown syntax. Ordered by `start`.

via_collapsed_into.description: Set when this segment has no standalone span and verification followed a RenderMap `collapsed_into` edge to the retained segment_id (M7, research §25.2).

oneOf.description: Per reviewed segment, the ORDERED closed-enum transform chain applied to its own characters (research §25.2, H1). Replaces the old `segment_edits` (dehyphenate-only).

incomplete.description: true iff a lineage hop could not be resolved (no reconciliation_decision_id, no semantic_block_ids, or no rendered span AND no recorded collapsed_into). Forces not_located (research §25.5).

oneOf.description: literal_content: the human-confirmed value VERBATIM (no strip / normalization / separator rewrite / BOM — FR-068 / FR-082).
reading_order: accepted_segment_ids in the human-confirmed sequence.

render_span.description: The authoritative rendered span for the whole reviewed location. NON-NULL iff the location resolved (failure_reason != not_located); `null` for not_located (H4, research §25.4).

per_segment_spans.description: Where each reviewed segment's own text landed — MAY be multiple spans per segment (M11). NON-NULL iff the location resolved; `null` for not_located (H4).

final_markdown_span_lc.description: Derived from render_span, 1-based codepoint columns — DISPLAY ONLY; render_span (codepoint offsets) is authoritative. NON-NULL iff the location resolved; `null` for not_located (H4).

final_markdown_excerpt.description: delivered_markdown_text[render_span.start : render_span.end] VERBATIM (codepoint slice). MUST NOT be .strip()'d, whitespace-collapsed, Unicode/punctuation-normalized, separator-rewritten, or wrapped in << >> (FR-082 / SC-034). Byte-identical to the corresponding span of the delivered artifact. `null` for not_located (H4, research §25.4).

failure_reason.description: Present (non-null) iff status = verification_failed (research §25.5). not_located: lineage incomplete / the reviewed segment has no rendered span and no recorded collapsed_into. literal_altered: the reviewed segment's own characters differ from apply(segment_transforms, expected.value) by something that is NOT an allowed transformation (interior spacing, a swapped decimal/thousand separator, a Unicode look-alike, punctuation). order_not_reflected: the rendered first-span order of the reviewed segments does not match the human-confirmed order and no valid logged structural_reorder covers it (M8).

defect_class.description: Present (non-null) iff status = verification_failed — the ORIGINATING STAGE (research §25.6 / H5 / FR-034a). reconciliation_error: lineage.ced_accepted != expected (or reconciliation_decision_id is null / not human_confirmed) — reconciliation did not apply the decision; routes back to the `review` layer (FR-045a). disallowed_transformation: ced_accepted == expected but a stage-3/5 transform altered the rendered span outside the recorded segment_transforms chain, or the segment vanished with no recorded collapsed_into — a deterministic-code fault; preferred repair is a code fix + re-run, escape hatch is `fix` + MANDATORY §25 re-verification (research §22.7). extraction_error: the confirmed value itself was a source-evidence fault (rare).

candidates_presented.description: Copied from the queue item for the Report (FR-081). The SOURCE-context copy MAY carry report-only markers in the rendered .md; final_markdown_excerpt MUST NOT (FR-082).

allOf.description: verification_failed => failure_reason and defect_class are non-null.
applied_and_verified => no failure fields, and the location resolved (spans + excerpt present).
not_located (H4) => every rendered-location field is null and the lineage is incomplete.
literal_altered / order_not_reflected => the location resolved, so render_span + excerpt are present (content/order is what is wrong).
